audience: health performance brand founder or marketing lead
cta: Review one claim against the receipt before publication.
information_gain_requirement: Make the claim record inspectable as five adjacent fields—claim, source, limit, reviewer, and update date—and explicitly separate retrieval readiness from observed citation performance.

measurement_hypothesis.falsifier: In the next internal review, a reviewer still cannot identify the claim, source, limit, reviewer, and update state after 7 days.
measurement_hypothesis.prediction: A claim-receipt answer may improve correct source-and-limit identification in internal review.

notes: Internal acceptance pilot only; The Angle Map remains the live offer canon.
risk_boundary: This is marketing and source-organization guidance, not medical, legal, regulatory, ranking, or citation advice.
structural_pattern: direct answer -> claim receipt -> worked example -> limits -> action
target_query: how should a supplement brand structure claims for human trust and AI inspection
